strings.name: Sunil Bharti Mittal
strings.summary: Mittal moved from bicycle components into telephone equipment and mobile services, building Bharti and Airtel. The company launched Delhi services in 1995, acquired African operations and invested in British and satellite telecommunications. He also led industry bodies including the ICC and supported education. His influence concerns operational growth, capital partnerships and connectivity, rather than personally inventing mobile technology.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Bharti telecom businesses, expanding mobile services in India and Africa and cross-border telecommunications investment.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 23 October 1957 in Ludhiana, Punjab, India.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Airtel networks
strings.highlights.h1.text: Expanded Indian mobile services and African operations into a large telecommunications business.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Cross-border investment
strings.highlights.h2.text: Connected Indian, African, British and satellite businesses through Bharti investments and partnerships.
strings.timeline.t1.title: French honor
strings.timeline.t1.text: France named him a Knight of the Legion of Honour for economic and communications ties.
strings.timeline.t2.title: BT investment announcement
strings.timeline.t2.text: Bharti announced a 24.5% BT stake acquisition, phased and subject to approvals and other conditions.
strings.timeline.t3.title: ICC chairman
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became chairman of the International Chamber of Commerce, serving through 2018.
strings.timeline.t4.title: African mobile expansion
strings.timeline.t4.text: Bharti Airtel acquired Zain’s mobile operations across 15 African countries.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Airtel listing
strings.timeline.t5.text: Bharti’s telecommunications business listed in India, expanding financing access.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Delhi mobile services
strings.timeline.t6.text: Launched GSM mobile services under the Airtel brand.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Telephone-equipment company
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established Bharti Telecom and developed telephone manufacturing through technical cooperation.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Early manufacturing venture
strings.timeline.t8.text: Established a bicycle-component manufacturing business in Ludhiana.
